proof_0361.moves: Exhibit X itself as the preimage witness, then observe that a ring hom maps X to X (map_X). The mathematical content is choosing the witness plus one computation lemma; the rest is simp proof-term residue.

proof_0362.moves: A definitional simp lemma: the inverse of the smulConst homeomorphism applied to a point is what its definition says, closed by rfl. The content is unfolding a definition, not a citation.

proof_0363.moves: Assemble the Connected structure from its two fields: preconnectedness comes from the edge-connectivity hypothesis, and nonemptiness of the vertex set is already available. Pure structure construction plus one projection.

proof_0364.moves: Definitional simp lemma computing the inverse of the uniqueAlgEquiv between MvPolynomial over a Unique index type and Polynomial; closed by rfl. All real weight is in the definition being unfolded; the long tail is typeclass instance bookkeeping.

proof_0365.moves: Two-step chain: finiteness gives torsion (isAddTorsion_of_finite), and torsion gives the module structure (module_of_torsion). Everything else is algebraic-hierarchy plumbing.

proof_0366.moves: A Raw-wrapper proof: unpack the well-formedness hypothesis with WF.out and hand the goal to the corresponding Internal.Impl lemma. No new mathematics; the unwrapping is the whole proof.

proof_0367.moves: Same wrapper pattern: extract the internal well-formedness proof and apply the Impl-level getD_modify lemma. Content is delegation.

proof_0368.moves: Transport the hash-map result to hash sets by viewing a set as a map with unit values, so size_insertMany reduces to size_insertManyIfNewUnit on the inner map; the pairwise-distinctness hypothesis carries over verbatim.

proof_0369.moves: Rewrite uniform summability as uniform convergence of partial sums via the characterization iff, apply monotonicity of TendstoUniformlyOn in the set, then convert back.

proof_0370.moves: The real-to-EReal coercion is defined so that toReal of a coerced real is the real itself; true by rfl. Pure definitional unfolding.

proof_0371.moves: The inclusion homomorphism induced by G ≤ G' pushes components forward, and this induced map on connected components is surjective; a surjection from a finite type bounds cardinality.

proof_0372.moves: The underlying set of a product of closed sets is by construction the product of the underlying sets, so rfl closes it. The content is that the SProd instance is defined that way.

proof_0373.moves: Specialize the more general 'continuous on a set contained in a compact set' result by taking the containing set to be the compact set itself, i.e. supply subset_rfl.

proof_0374.moves: Recognize multiplication in the target as the scalar action of the ring on itself, so the statement is literally the smul₀ version applied through instSMulOfMul.

proof_0375.moves: Rewrite almost-everywhere equality of an intersection componentwise (ae_eq_set_inter), use the hypothesis s =ᵃᵉ univ on the left factor and reflexivity on the right, then simplify univ ∩ t to t.

proof_0376.moves: A global integral curve satisfies the defining derivative condition at every point; weaken each HasDerivAt to a HasDerivWithinAt on the given set. One weakening lemma applied pointwise.

proof_0377.moves: Rewrite the union of a countable family of sets as an indexed union over the family itself (sUnion_eq_biUnion), then invoke the biUnion version of the restriction-congruence theorem.

proof_0378.moves: Membership in the orthogonal complement of a closed submodule is by definition membership in the orthogonal complement of its underlying submodule, so Iff.rfl closes it. Pure definitional transparency; the rest is the normed/inner-product typeclass tower.

proof_0379.moves: The arithmetic-geometric mean is at least the minimum of its two arguments, and the minimum of two positive numbers is positive; chain the strict inequality through the non-strict one.

proof_0380.moves: Apply the characterization of when natSepDegree is additive on a product, and discharge its disjunctive side condition by picking the branch that coprimality supplies (the factors share no common root/are not both zero).

proof_0381.moves: The ball of radius infDist x sᶜ is contained in the complement of sᶜ; then use double-complement to identify that with s. One containment lemma plus one rewrite.

proof_0382.moves: Build the FiniteType instance for the subcomplex: for each dimension the subcomplex's cell index set is a subtype of the ambient complex's cell index set, which is finite by hypothesis, so subtypes of a finite type are finite.

proof_0383.moves: Commute the two summands so that the fixed measure sits on the right, then apply the already-proved right-cancellation for sigma-finite measures.

proof_0384.moves: Compose the given filter convergence with the fact that the norm is continuous (tendsto_norm), i.e. Tendsto.comp of norm-continuity after the hypothesis.
